parts.name: 01_rib_cage
parts.orientation: Front annulus face down; arch and grip rise above the plate.
parts.support_caution: Supports from the build plate are required beneath elevated ribs and grip. Inspect visible surfaces and support access in the slicer.

parts.name: 02_chassis
parts.orientation: Front wall face down; the rear cavity opens upward.
parts.support_caution: Inspect local supports beneath internal screw bridges; keep fastener bores and the optical opening clear.

parts.name: 03_rear_cover
parts.orientation: Exterior rear face down; locating lip points upward.
parts.support_caution: Normally no supports; inspect countersinks and lip starts.

parts.name: 04_esp32_carrier
parts.orientation: Broad rear frame face down; PCB rails point upward.
parts.support_caution: Keep PCB grooves free of supports; inspect short bridges over the grooves.

parts.name: 05_board_clamp
parts.orientation: Broad horizontal face down.
parts.support_caution: Normally no supports; retain calibrated hole and slot sizes.

parts.name: 06_optical_baffle
parts.orientation: Broad front disc face down; posts or stem point upward.
parts.support_caution: Normally no supports; keep optical bore and screw holes clear. Remove optional blank parts before fitting real optics.

parts.name: 07_shutter
parts.orientation: Control cap top face down; stem points upward.
parts.support_caution: Inspect the cap rim and small horizontal pin hole; avoid support material inside fits.

parts.name: 08_shutter_pin
parts.orientation: Pin axis Y horizontal; split barb bending in X remains in the layer plane.
parts.support_caution: Inspect the small barrel contact area and head overhang; use a removable brim and local supports if needed. Keep the barb slit clear and test retention with the shutter calibration coupon.

parts.name: 09_rear_dial
parts.orientation: Control cap top face down; stem points upward.
parts.support_caution: Inspect the cap rim and small horizontal pin hole; avoid support material inside fits.

parts.name: 10_io_plate
parts.orientation: Broad side face down; port opening remains vertical through the print.
parts.support_caution: Normally no supports; verify the actual connector and plug envelope before installation.

parts.name: 12_lens_blank
parts.orientation: Broad front disc face down; posts or stem point upward.
parts.support_caution: Normally no supports; keep optical bore and screw holes clear. Remove optional blank parts before fitting real optics.

parts.name: 13_lens_blank_retainer
parts.orientation: Broad front disc face down; posts or stem point upward.
parts.support_caution: Normally no supports; keep optical bore and screw holes clear. Remove optional blank parts before fitting real optics.

parts.name: 14_dial_retainer
parts.orientation: Broad horizontal face down.
parts.support_caution: Normally no supports; retain calibrated hole and slot sizes.

parts.name: 15_shutter_return_flexure
parts.orientation: Original positive X face down; flexure length Y and bending direction Z remain in the layer plane.
parts.support_caution: Keep the thin leaf free of supports. Inspect adhesion and use a removable brim if needed; validate elastic return with the shutter calibration coupon before assembly.

parts.name: 17_camera_saddle
parts.orientation: Largest exterior planar support face selected automatically.
parts.support_caution: Inspect the selected face, overhangs, fastening access and thin features in the slicer.

parts.name: 18_camera_clamp
parts.orientation: Broad horizontal face down.
parts.support_caution: Normally no supports; retain calibrated hole and slot sizes.

parts.name: 19_usb_retainer
parts.orientation: Broad horizontal face down.
parts.support_caution: Normally no supports; retain calibrated hole and slot sizes.

parts.name: 20_shutter_service_cover
parts.orientation: Original positive X planar side face down; the curved cap and bearing rise above the plate.
parts.support_caution: Use a removable brim for the small contact face. Inspect local supports beneath the bearing overhang and curved skin; keep the fastening bore clear.

parts.name: 11_fit_coupon
parts.orientation: Original broad base face down; calibration features remain upright.
parts.support_caution: Print before the fitted parts. Measure the holes and flexure samples with the intended material and nozzle; retain the calibrated feature sizes.

parts.name: 16_shutter_calibration
parts.orientation: Original broad base face down; calibration features remain upright.
parts.support_caution: Print before the fitted parts. Measure the holes and flexure samples with the intended material and nozzle; retain the calibrated feature sizes.

instructions: Generic standards-based 3MF geometry in millimetres. Open in the slicer, select the actual printer/nozzle/material, add the indicated supports or brim, inspect toolpaths, then slice. Colours indicate suggested filament groups only and do not assign extruders. Print the fit coupon first.
